svg.title: deguboard development flow
svg.desc: You, your team and agents work in a loop, and the whole team sees the same board. An agent fleshes out your idea into small tickets with acceptance criteria, which you approve. An agent orders them into a plan in dependency order, which you approve. In the Iteration, agents work on unblocked tickets in parallel, with the time and tokens of each ticket shown; each one passes the quality gate (checks and a review by another agent), fails go back to work, and it is merged while you monitor the Iteration. An agent reviews the whole repository and you approve the release. An agent reports the time, tokens and rework per step with trends, you choose the improvements, and they become improvements to the agents and the software.
svg.text: Improvements to the agents and the software
Describe the idea, and approve the tickets, the plan,
each merge and the release. Choose what to improve.
The whole team sees the same board, and anyone can approve.
Write the tickets, plan the order, build several at once,
review each other's work and report what it cost.
